notes.title: MARK THE DATE! POCKET GARDEN COMING MAY 27 📅 Pocket Garden Developer Update #3
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Gardeners! 🪴💛[/b][/h1]

We’ve been quietly tending to our little corner of digital earth, planting ideas, pulling weeds, and watching Pocket Garden slowly blossom into something we’re truly proud of. Today, we’re thrilled to finally share the news with you:

[h2][b]📅 Pocket Garden releases on May 27, 2025 at 8:00 PM CEST![/b][/h2]

That’s right — just a few more weeks until you can start planting, decorating, and building your dream garden at your own pace, with no pressure, no timers, and no resource management. Just pure, relaxing creativity.

We want to thank you all for your support, wishlists, and warm messages. Your excitement has kept us going through every sprout and setback. 🐝🌱

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288787/2403865bc81ceeb4ace8185162353959e70e3635.gif[/img]

As we get closer to launch, we’ll be sharing a few more sneak peeks, dev insights, and maybe even some cozy behind-the-scenes content from the team.

Don’t forget to wishlist Pocket Garden if you haven’t already — it really helps more cozy gamers discover our little world!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161430/Pocket_Garden/

Stay cozy,
Pocket Team 🌸

notes.title: FREE DEMO IS AVAILABLE ON STEAM NEXT FEST! 🤯 Pocket Garden Developer Update #2
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Play the Free Demo During Steam Next Fest! 🎉[/b][/h1]

Hello, Pocket Gardeners!

The wait is over — [b]Pocket Garden demo is now available as part of Steam Next Fest, February 2025! 🎊[/b] You can download it right now and start designing your dream garden. Whether you’re crafting a cozy little corner or an expansive floral paradise, there are no limits—just pure creativity!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3458190/Pocket_Garden_Demo/

If you haven't already, wishlist Pocket Garden on Steam and dive into the demo today! And don’t forget — we’d love to see your beautiful creations, so share your gardens with us in the Steam discussions or on social media! 🌿✨

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161430/Pocket_Garden/

[h2][b]🪴 Say Hello to the Cutest Garden Gnome![/b][/h2]

As you explore the demo, you might spot a tiny but very important guardian of the gardens — a charming little gnome! 🏡🧙‍♂️ This delightful decoration is here to bring a little magic to your green spaces. Whether he’s hiding under a tree, resting by a pond, or keeping watch over your flowers, he’s always there, adding a touch of coziness. So, don’t be shy — give him a wave when you pass by! Who knows? Maybe he has a few garden secrets to share. 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288787/aa22243538688d7680ed9e7941f6972d66bb8ded.gif[/img]

[h2][b]🌹 Watch a Beautiful Rose Come to Life![/b][/h2]
One of the most satisfying parts of game development is seeing small details come together, and what’s a garden without beautiful flowers? Marcin, one of our developers, has recorded a timelapse of modeling a delicate rose from scratch! 🌸 From the first petal to the final bloom, it’s mesmerizing to watch how a simple idea transforms into a stunning in-game decoration. Check out the video and see the magic unfold!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288787/291d3bedd6646afe5c52ab2842013a1a3594964a.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288787/b51ff09fe165edba9f8cf7176ba8a4d293d33868.png[/img]

That’s all for now, but stay tuned for more updates! The Pocket Garden demo is waiting for you — go build your dream garden now! 🌻💚

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3458190/Pocket_Garden_Demo/

[h2][b]Happy gardening! 🌿✨[/b][/h2]

notes.title: Your little dream oasis starts here! 🌱 Pocket Garden Developer Update #1
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Welcome to Pocket Garden! 🌻🐝[/b][/h1]

Hello, green thumbs and cozy game lovers! 🌱

We’re absolutely thrilled to welcome you to Pocket Garden’s very first devlog. Whether you’ve already started dreaming about your perfect little oasis or you’re here to see what all the buzz is about, we’re so happy you’re here.

In Pocket Garden, it’s all about creating a garden that feels like home - your home. We’ve been working hard to make every plant, every decoration, and every tiny critter a delight to discover. And today, we’re giving you a sneak peek at two special additions to your garden!

[h2][b]🌻 Say Hello to Sunflowers[/b][/h2]
Nothing brightens up your garden like a cheerful sunflower! These cuties will grow tall and proud, spreading joy to every corner of your plot. Check out this adorable rotating preview of the sunflower model below. Doesn’t it just make you want to start planting?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288787/d0676ff1c143bb149d34a67052528ce5bee5cced.gif[/img]

[h2][b]🐝 Build a Buzzing Bee Hive[/b][/h2]
Gardens aren’t just about plants - they’re home to tiny helpers, too! Our bee hive decoration not only looks cozy, but it also attracts some friendly, buzzing bees to your plot. They’ll happily zip around, adding life and charm to your space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45288787/aa723f2c459b9039703907998542365401a771bf.gif[/img]

That’s it for this first devlog, but it’s only the beginning! We can’t wait to show you more of what’s blooming in Pocket Garden. From new decorations and plants to surprise features, we’re growing something truly special together.

We’d love to hear what you think! What plants, features, or cozy vibes do you want to see in Pocket Garden? Drop your ideas in the comments - we’re all ears! Also, don't forget to add the game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161430

[i]~ Marcin & Kacper
The Pocket Garden Team 🌸[/i]
